mode.serverHelp: A backend ships with the site: it can query the models and holds the API key, which never passes through your browser.
mode.clientHelp: The site runs on its own, with no backend. It can still query an API (Ollama, OpenRouter…) directly from your browser, if you configure one in the settings.
mode.offlineHelp: No network calls: the session replays answers genuinely produced by these models and recorded in advance, with their timings and token counts.
